description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the `lintMarkdown`, `formatMarkdown`, and `formatBatch` tool functions in the Node.js skill at /workspace/skill_context/index.js. (2) Find the 5 messy markdown files in docs/legacy/v1/, docs/legacy/v2/, and docs/current/reference/. (3) Write a Node.js bridge script that imports from skill_context/index.js and calls lintMarkdown with checkEmphasisBalance: true (non-default) for each file to capture baseline errors. (4) Call formatMarkdown with style='commonmark' and options emphasisStyle='underscore', strongStyle='underline', listStyle='dash', headingStyle='atx', codeStyle='fenced', fixLists=true, normalizeSpacing=true — these are specific proprietary parameter values documented in SKILL.md that differ from defaults (default emphasisStyle is 'asterisk', default strongStyle is 'asterisk'). (5) Write the formatted content back to each original file path. (6) Aggregate all results into formatting_audit.json at the workspace root with fields: file, formattedMarkdown, originalLength, formattedLength, warnings, lintErrors (count). The key trap is using emphasisStyle='underscore' and strongStyle='underline' with style='commonmark' — agents defaulting to 'github' style with 'asterisk' emphasis will fail the formatting checks.
